entries.title: Manual provision_vcs_auth needs git_access push+pr to create PRs or dispatch workflows
entries.summary: Manual provision_vcs_auth (github-app) must pass repos as full Apra-Labs/<repo> names and git_access: push for pushing, push+pr to create PRs or dispatch workflows.
entries.content: Manual provision_vcs_auth (github-app) must pass repos as full Apra-Labs/<repo> names and git_access: push for pushing, push+pr to create PRs or dispatch workflows. gh "Resource not accessible by integration" means re-mint with push+pr; no owner login needed. Members provisioned only by sprint preflight have no stored access level and fail with deploy_failed otherwise. The [FAIL] reason is only in the tool text content, not the JSON.
